summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CMT Daily Recap (Rekap Harian) feature - backend APIs, frontend UI, integration flows, and regression testing. All tests passed successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: All 14 API tests passed (14/14)
Backend RBAC: Authorized roles (admin, supervisor) can access - 403 for HR and vendor accounts
Backend Structure: Daily recap returns correct structure with date, tasks, summary, rows
Backend Date Navigation: Date parameter works, invalid dates return 400
Backend Vendor Coverage: All 3 active vendors appear in recap
Backend Task States: All task states (done/partial/pending/none) are valid
Backend Export: Excel (XLSX) and PDF exports work correctly with proper filenames
Backend Reminder: Reminder endpoint accessible and returns correct structure
Backend Consistency: Summary numbers match row counts perfectly
Frontend: All UI elements present and functional
Frontend: Rekap Harian panel visible at top of Input Vendor CMT portal
Frontend: All 5 summary cards displayed (Belum diisi, Sebagian, Lengkap, Tanpa pekerjaan, Tugas belum diisi)
Frontend: Date navigation controls work (prev/next day, date input, today button)
Frontend: Export buttons (Excel, PDF) present and functional
Frontend: Filter 'Hanya yang belum lengkap' works correctly
Frontend: Search functionality filters vendors correctly
Frontend: Reminder button shows correct count and is clickable
Frontend: Vendor rows display with correct status badges and task cells
Frontend: All 5 task columns present (Terima Material, Inspeksi Material, Progress Produksi, Kirim ke DA/Buyer, Balas Reminder)
Frontend: Task cells show correct states (pending/done/partial/none) with data-state attributes
Frontend: Date navigation to 2026-08-08 works - shows 'TANGGAL LAIN' badge and 'as of' note
Frontend: Click-through from recap to override mode works perfectly
Frontend: Override mode shows vendor name, staff name, and 'Ganti vendor' button
Frontend: Return from override mode back to recap works
Frontend: No JavaScript errors on page
Regression: Vendor portal (cmtvendor@dewiaditya.id) still works correctly
Regression: Vendor can login and see dashboard without errors
Regression: No breaking changes to existing vendor portal functionality
